# KRGV Channel 5 News

> > KRGV Channel 5 News delivers local coverage of the Rio Grande Valley with breaking news, community initiatives, and regional developments.

KRGV is the primary news source for the Rio Grande Valley region, covering Hidalgo County, Cameron County, and surrounding areas including Harlingen, Edcouch, and Nuevo Progreso. The station provides comprehensive local news coverage, live streaming, and community-focused programming segments.

## Key Topics

- Rio Grande Valley
- Harlingen
- Local News
- Community Outreach
- Elections
- Infrastructure Projects
- Volunteer Fire Department
- Hidalgo County
- Cameron County
- Flood Prevention
- Park Renovation
- Equipment Donation
- Health Segments
- Local Business

## Live News & Streaming

- [KRGV News Live Stream](https://www.krgv.com/krgv-5-1-news-live-stream): Live stream and video-on-demand access to KRGV Channel 5 news broadcasts

## Elections & Politics

- [Elections](https://www.krgv.com/elections): Election coverage and results for Hidalgo County and Rio Grande Valley

## Local News & Community

- [700 homes to benefit from Harlingen drainage project](https://www.krgv.com/news/700-homes-to-benefit-from-harlingen-drainage-project): Harlingen's $700,000 detention pond expansion protects 700 homes from flooding
- [Upgrades coming to Victor Park in Harlingen](https://www.krgv.com/news/upgrades-coming-to-victor-park-in-harlingen): Victor Park in Harlingen receives $750,000 renovation with pool and splash pad upgrades
- [Edcouch Volunteer Fire Department donating gear to Nuevo Progreso crews](https://www.krgv.com/news/edcouch-volunteer-fire-department-donating-gear-to-nuevo-progreso-crews): Edcouch Volunteer Fire Department donates 20 sets of firefighting gear to Nuevo Progreso, Mexico crews

## Featured Segments

- [Made in the 956](https://www.krgv.com/made-in-the-956): Showcase of local Rio Grande Valley businesses and products like Elevate Adaptive Fitness
- [Heart of the Valley](https://www.krgv.com/heart-of-the-valley): Health segment featuring cardiology and heart disease prevention content

- [Find the Link](https://www.krgv.com/find-the-link): Community resource directory with links to local government and public services
